messages:
alex: heads-up — noticed noisy alerts during the canary rollout to eu-west-1. lots of 'request_p50' spikes but dashboards show nothing obvious. tagging oncall.

maria: I saw that too. deploy-bot said canary started ~10m ago. which alerts are firing?

sam: Alert name is `svc_token_request_p50_high` and also `svc_error_rate_5m`. Lots of duplicates, different host tags.

jin: incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2123456789 - Canary alert storm (eu-west-1). Severity: sev2. Paging alex, maria.

alex: Confirming impact: customer-facing API latencies look elevated for a subset of customers on the new canary shard. We have error rate increase ~0.8% from 0.05%.

maria: I'm checking logs. Quick note — the new release renamed metric `token_request.p50` -> `svc.token.latency_p50` in the code. If alerts still reference the old metric name we'll have bad signal.

sam: That explains missing graphs. The main dashboard queries `token_request.p50` so it returns empty and our runbook failed to show the spike. Alerts firing are based on legacy metric that got duplicated during canary (old metric emitting and new metric emitting side-by-side) causing doubled series.

alex: Oof. So two problems: dashboards don't show the canonical metric (they're pointing at the renamed one) and the alert grouping/routing exploded because hosts reported both metrics briefly. Need quick mitigation — either pause rollout or kill flag.

jin: deploy-bot: Canary rollout step 3/5 completed. Flavor: model-serving v2. Want a manual rollback or flag kill?

maria: We should kill the feature flag for eu-west-1 only. Rolling back full release would be heavy. Can someone flip the kill switch?

sam: I tried to hit the kill endpoint but got 403 from the feature flag service — my token doesn't have permission for regional kills.

ops-sre: I can flip it, but confirm scope. Are we disabling the canary traffic router or disabling metric emission in the image?

alex: Disable canary traffic routing — route back to stable for eu-west-1. We still want telemetry to continue from stable.

ops-sre: Doing `ff-toggle --env=prod --region=eu-west-1 --flag=canary_v2 --state=off` now.

ops-sre: done. deploy-bot: Canary routing disabled in eu-west-1.

incident-bot: Update INC-2123456789: mitigation in progress — canary routing turned off for eu-west-1.

alex: Thanks. Can we verify error rate and p50 after kill?

maria: Pulling metrics now. Error rate dropped back to baseline within 2 minutes, p50 tail normalized. But alert flood still happening due to duplicate historical alerts in the alert queue.

sam: We should mute the noisy alerts while we clean the queries. I'm going to patch the alert definitions to: 1) use the canonical name `svc.token.latency_p50` and 2) add `source:canary` label so grouping reduces noise.

ops-sre: Agreed, but be careful — we don't want to mute legitimate customer impact signals. Use short mute window (15m) and mention on call.

maria: Created a temporary alert mute for `svc_token_request_p50_high` and `svc_error_rate_5m` across eu-west-1 for 15m. Note in incident: temporary mute to prevent alert storms while we patch queries.

alex: Good. Also update dashboards: I pushed a small change to the dashboard query to include both metric names while we migrate, with a note: `# migration: show old and new metric names for 24h` so oncall can see both signals.

sam: Patch for alert defs is ready, testing in staging now. Plan to roll to prod in 5m.

jin: Incident-bot: Page escalation check — any customer-facing SLAs breached?

alex: Quick calc: small set of customers (approx 4) saw degraded responses for ~8 minutes. No SLO target breach at account-level, but we should file a customer-impact ticket and notify the success team.

maria: I'll open CS ticket and attach logs/traces for the affected customer ids.

ops-sre: After alert patch and dashboard temporary fallback, we should run a short canary restart with metric backward-compatibility. We need the code change to emit both metric names for a 24h window to avoid future tears.

sam: Agreed — build patch to emit `token_request.p50` alias pointing to `svc.token.latency_p50`. Also add a migration flag. I'll get a PR up.

alex: Postmortem checklist in thread: 1) Fix alert query and grouping 2) Add regional kill-switch perms to SRE/ops role (so we don't get 403s) 3) Improve dashboard migration docs and include migration toggle 4) Add automated pre-deploy check that validates metric name changes will not orphan dashboards or alerts 5) Notify CS + include customer impact summary

maria: Adding action items to INC-2123456789. Assigning owners: sam -> alert/dashboard fixes, ops-sre -> flag perms, alex -> pre-deploy check, maria -> CS comms + incident notes.

jin: Incident-bot: Incident marked as mitigated. Root cause: metric rename + canary duplicate emissions + insufficient kill-switch permissions leading to delayed mitigation. Follow-up required.

alex: Thanks all. If alert noise reappears after we re-enable regional canary, we'll do a controlled test with traffic slice and metric aliasing on.

maria: closing loop — will post postmortem draft in #postmortems and link here. :thumbsup:
